name: Moonsilver Blade
blurb: Innate:  Diana gains  attack speed, increased shortly after casting an ability.

effects.description: Innate: Diana gains 15% - 37.35% (based on level) bonus attack speed. After casting an ability, this bonus is tripled to 45% - 112.06% (based on level) for 5 seconds.

Innate - Moonsilver Blade: Diana's basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Moonsilver Blade for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, Diana empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks on-hit to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them 20 - 270 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage. Moonsilver Blade deals 270% damage against monsters.

notes:
Moonsilver Blade will affect  structures.
Each attack has a distinct animation and she will glow when the empowered attack is ready.
Sometimes, the empowered basic attack will not consume the stacks.(bug)
In this case, the attack will also not deal its damage.
